_comment: NPC dialogue for mireille (Phase E §3 barks; quest lines land with Act 1).

barks.text: I don't want your forgiveness. I want the door behind me closed.
They told me the fires were holy. I stood in one. It was just fire.
I know the Choir's rites better than any of their chanters. Don't make me use them.
Say my name somewhere public and I'll be dead by morning.
